import ast, pathlib
text = pathlib.Path('app.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
tree = ast.parse(text)
body = tree.body
ok = (
    len(body) == 1
    and isinstance(body[0], ast.Expr)
    and isinstance(body[0].value, ast.Call)
    and isinstance(body[0].value.func, ast.Name)
    and body[0].value.func.id == 'print'
    and len(body[0].value.args) == 1
    and isinstance(body[0].value.args[0], ast.Constant)
    and body[0].value.args[0].value == 'updated'
    and not body[0].value.keywords
)
if not ok:
    raise SystemExit('app.py is not a single print("updated") call: ' + repr(text))
